high_level_description: The image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the account "summachar_in." The post features a futuristic architectural design for a school, specifically highlighting an "Infinity Loop Track." The text on the image reads: INFINITY LOOP TRACK The proposed design plans to clean and purify the air around it. At the top of the school, an infinity cycling track will allow students to exercise. The image shows a cylindrical building with a unique design that incorporates greenery. The structure appears to be covered with vertical gardens, giving it a lush, forest-like appearance.
